items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: He was a good, nice actor. A Wonderful Smith.

ctx.x: Uh huh. And I understand that John Garfield was one of the people who backed it. Do you remember that?
No, I don't. I don't remember, but there was quite a few people in there that was interested in that show. He was a good, nice actor. A Wonderful Smith.
A Wonderful Smith, yes. I understand he is a minister now.
